# Station Engineer [color=#f39f27]Engineering[/color] is a combination of [textlink="construction" link="Construction"] work, [textlink="repair" link="ExpandingRepairingStation"] work, maintaining a death machine that happens to produce [textlink="power" link="Power"].
## Personnel [color=#f39f27]Engineering[/color]'s staff is made up of Station Engineers, Atmospheric Technicians, and Firefighters.
## Tools
Your core toolset is a small variety of tools. If you're an engineer, then you should have a belt on your waist containing one of each; if not, you can likely find them in maintenance shafts and in tool storage within assorted toolboxes and vending machines.
Your primary task as an engineer is setting up and maintaining the [textlink="AME" link="AME"], and following that it is general upkeep of the station and, possibly, handling [textlink="AtmosphericTechnician" link="Atmos's"] job when things go south.
